items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: When they were playing with Sam Morgan, after they were with Sam Morgan.

ctx.x: When they were playing with Sam Morgan, after they were with Sam Morgan. Daddy was with Sam Morgan, after. Oh yeah.

I wanted to ask you, whatever happened to those different other guys in Richard Taylor's little band? Who was the leader of it anyway? That's the first thing. Did you have a leader in that first band?
